QuestInfo.name: The Gale Gourd
QuestInfo.0: Maple World hums with energy because of Tempest. To take advantage of that energy, Cassandra has a request for you. \n
QuestInfo.1: Hold on to the #bGale Gourd#k that Cassandra gave you for #r20 minutes#k to let it fill up with the mysterious power of the tempestuous wind. Then bring it to Cassandra. #bRemember, if you log out before it's full, the gourd will disappear.#k
QuestInfo.2: You filled the Gale Gourd for Cassandra and received Pendant of the Spirit in exchange.

0.0: #b#h0##k, Maple World is currently celebrating the arrival of Hot Summer. It's wonderful! I think I've printed thousands of pamphlets already, and there's nothing I love more than collating! But I need your help with something.\r\n#r(Only one Character per world can participate in the Gale Gourd Event.) #k

It'll transform into a #r#i3994935##t3994935##k, which you can bring to me. #bJust remember, if you log out before the gourd is full, it'll disappear!#k You'll have to start over!
